snippet.title: One Million Coins - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation. 

The game will be available on Steam on October 13!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5258340/One_Million_Coins/
